objective: Make the multi-system estate immediately legible as a coordinated set of distinct systems while preserving Keddeh Systems authority and the ENGINEER · AUTOMATE · SCALE line.
brand_invariants: Frontage Foundry and Website Foundry remain distinct

concepts.name: Operational atlas
concepts.semantic_intent: A precise spatial map shows bounded systems, handoffs and operating evidence.
concepts.decision_supported: Helps a visitor select the right capability without treating the estate as one product.
concepts.differentiator: Uses route topology and live evidence states rather than generic service cards.

concepts.name: Proof ledger
concepts.semantic_intent: A restrained editorial system foregrounds verified outcomes, contracts and release evidence.
concepts.decision_supported: Helps a technical buyer judge credibility and delivery maturity.
concepts.differentiator: Uses artifact provenance and readback evidence as the visual rhythm.

visual_system.icon_rule: Use simple owner-authored vector symbols with visible labels; never use icon-only critical controls.

alternative.text: A topology of distinct Foundry systems showing Frontage Foundry defining the market experience, Website Foundry implementing it, and Publishing, Domain and Server Foundries delivering it under Foundry Fabric coordination.
